subject: Security

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: CI workflow runs no secret-detection scan before merge

evidence.excerpt: steps: checkout, setup-dotnet, dotnet restore, dotnet build, dotnet test

findings.standard: OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet — SMG-05
findings.recommendation: Add a secret-scanning step (e.g. gitleaks or GitHub secret scanning/push protection) to the pull_request workflow and a matching pre-commit hook.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: SQL Server connection string disables server-certificate validation while sending database credentials
findings.standard: OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet — SMG-11
findings.recommendation: Remove TrustServerCertificate=True (or make it a development-only setting) and require encrypted connections with certificate validation for both SQL Server and PostgreSQL credential exchanges.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Base appsettings.json (all environments) carries development data-source values
findings.standard: OWASP Secure Code Review Cheat Sheet — SCR-02
findings.recommendation: Keep development host/user values only in appsettings.Development.json and leave the base file with empty or environment-supplied values so production cannot silently inherit development settings.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Anonymous test-data reset endpoint served on the public listener with no environment or network restriction
findings.standard: OWASP REST Security Cheat Sheet — ORS-01
findings.recommendation: Register the testing/reset controller only in Development or test environments, or serve it on a separate restricted port/host (network allowlist).

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Data-deleting reset operation logs only failures, not its use

evidence.excerpt: public async Task<IActionResult> ResetTesting(...) { var response = await testingService.ResetTestingAsync(cancellationToken);
result = await connection.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync<int>(command); transaction.Commit(); ... return new RetrieveResponse<int>(result);

findings.recommendation: Log each reset invocation and its outcome (caller/source address, deleted row count, result) through ILogger with structured parameters (OWASP Top 10 A09).

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Database connection and transaction not disposed; connection leaks if BeginTransaction or command setup throws

evidence.excerpt: var connection = CreateConnection(...); ... connection.Open(); ... var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();

findings.recommendation: Wrap the connection and transaction in using declarations (await using where supported) so both are released on every exception path.

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: Global exception middleware logs the exception and returns a generic ProblemDetails with only a correlation ID
strengths.standard: OWASP Error Handling Cheat Sheet — ERR-02

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: Data-source configuration redacts the password in ToString and copy-with-suppression

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: File log sink is size-capped, rolled daily with bounded retention and structured JSON output
